question: Bala Saraswati was a prominent exponent of which classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is** Bharatanatyam.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tanjore Balasaraswati, **also known as Balasaraswati, was an Indian dancer, and** her rendering of Bharatanatyam**.
 
• A classical dance style originated in the** South Indian state of Tamil Nadu.**
 
• **Balasaraswati** became a sought-after dancer.
 
• ​Tutelage under Kandappa Pillai continued along with guidance from Gauri Ammal and Chinnaya Naidu.
 
• Balasaraswati, The dancer who popularised Bharatnatyam to the world.
 
• She founded the Dipasikha Dance Foundation in Chennai.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi **is a dance-drama performance, with its roots in the ancient** Hindu Sanskrit text of Natya Shastra.**
 
• **Odissi **is a dance form from the state of **Odisha in eastern India.**
 
• **Mohiniyattam **is a graceful dance to watch and is a solo recital by women.
